svg.text: GPU (CUDA / ibverbs) vs NPU (Ascend / HiXL) -- Dual Backend
Auto-set by framework / Same-card multi-proc RDMA: YES
Manual bootstrap npu_device(N) / Same-card RDMA: NO
Python API and Rust Actor framework are fully shared. Backend is switched at compile time via Cargo feature flags (tensor_engine vs ascend_engine).
